source_fragments.text:
The player takes the alien sheets corresponding to
the two flares and looks at them in secret, choosing one of
the two aliens to play during this game. The chosen alien is
placed facedown in front of the player, while the other alien
sheet is returned to the box.

4. Choose Aliens: Shuffle the flare cards and deal two 
facedown to each player. Each player takes the two alien 
sheets matching their flare cards, chooses one sheet to 
keep, and returns the other to the game box. Then, all 
players reveal their chosen sheet simultaneously.

5. Prepare Cosmic Deck: Collect the flare cards that 
were dealt to each player; if playing with fewer than 
five players, add additional flares randomly to bring 
the total to 10. Then, shuffle those 10 flares with the 
encounter, reinforcement, and artifact cards to create the 
cosmic deck.

Prepare Flares:
5.
The flares dealt to each player are then
taken and added to the cosmic deck.

Deal Hands:
6.
Each player is then dealt a hand of eight cards
from the cosmic deck, and the remainder of the deck is
placed near the center of the playing area.

required_facts: Deal two shuffled flares to each player; secretly choose one corresponding alien, return other sheet.
Include all six dealt flares plus four random extra flares: ten total.
Eight-card hands.
Draw destiny until a player color appears, that player starts; shuffle drawn card back into destiny.
Remove the alien bearing the printed restriction; retain the one without it.
The affected player may use its previously rejected alien or draw a replacement flare and become that alien.
Redraw if the replacement produces another conflict.
Warp in center; each player chooses a color and takes its five planets.
Each player has twenty ships, four on each home planet.
Colony markers begin beside the warp at zero foreign colonies.
Remove destiny cards for unused player colors; retain used colors, wilds and specials and shuffle.
Use either standard or classic Filch flare, only one version; return the other to box.
